# 100.00 USD arriving as one entry: 60.00 clearing the receivable, 40.00 booked to income.
#
# The transaction of `money_arriving_as_two_receivable_splits.txt`, with the
# same guids, and its second split on `Income:Other USD` rather than on the
# receivable. A payment may take a split off an account money passes through,
# and never off an income account for an invoice: that would take the sale off
# the profit and loss.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction with three splits, one of them
# on the receivable and one on income, neither in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_grouped_payment_stating_a_split_on_income_is_refused.py.
2026-01-01 open Income:Other USD
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-02-27 * "Money in, a receivable line and an income line"
	guid: "5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f80912233445"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091223344556"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -60.00 USD
		guid: "708192a3b4c5d6e7f809122334455667"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Income:Other USD -40.00 USD
		guid: "8192a3b4c5d6e7f80912233445566778"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
